• Ideal for TV, Audio/Video, Gaming & Wearables.Introducing the Baseus Earphone Bluetooth Bowie H1 wireless headphones with BT 5.2 and ANC (Active Noise Cancelling). These over the ear headphones are perfect for those who want to enjoy their music without any distractions. With the latest BT 5.2 technology, you can easily connect your device and enjoy high-quality sound. The ANC feature cancels out any unwanted noise, making it perfect for use in noisy environments. These headphones are compatible with a wide range of devices and are perfect for use while watching TV, gaming, or simply listening to music. Get your hands on the Baseus Earphone Bluetooth Bowie H1 wireless headphones today and experience the ultimate listening experience.
